programme.title: Feriado
programme.desc: Juan Pablo, de 16 años, viaja a la remota hacienda familiar en los Andes, donde su tío, implicado en un escándalo de corrupción, se ha refugiado con su esposa y sus hijos adolescentes. Es el feriado de carnaval de 1999, pocos días antes del colapso del sistema bancario ecuatoriano. Allí, Juan Pablo conoce a Juano, un enigmático y seguro fanático del black metal del pueblo cercano, que le abre los ojos a un universo nuevo y liberador. Mientras su país y su familia se precipitan hacia el abismo, la naciente amistad entre los chicos se convierte en un frágil romance, y Juan Pablo se ve obligado a definirse frente a su caótico entorno.

programme.title: Mi último Round
programme.desc: En el sur de Chile nace una historia de amor entre Octavio, un boxeador exitoso, y Hugo, un ayudante de cocina. Al mudarse a la capital, Santiago, esperan cumplir sus sueños y vivir su amor, desafiando en secreto la hostilidad del mundo exterior. Pero nada resulta como lo habían planeado: mientras Hugo conoce a Jennifer, quien le muestra un mundo desconocido, Octavio vuelve a intentar lo que mejor sabe hacer: boxear. Pero esta vez no busca la victoria. Esta pelea podría ser una nueva salida o su último round.

programme.title: Yo No Me Llamo Ruben Blades
programme.desc: El ícono latinoamericano Rubén Blades fue una figura central de la revolución salsera neoyorquina de los años 70, combinando letras de fuerte contenido social con ritmos explosivos que llegaron a audiencias de todo el mundo. Ganador de 17 premios Grammy, abogado formado en Harvard, actor de Hollywood y ex candidato presidencial, Blades reflexiona sobre su carrera de 50 años en este retrato íntimo del aclamado director Abner Benaim.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.desc: Visto il successo che iCarly riscuote sul web, il funzionario di un'emittente televisiva contatta i ragazzi e propone loro di trasferire gli episodi in televisione.

programme.title: iCarly: L'odioso ragazzo di Sam
programme.desc: Quando la nuova relazione di Sam inizia a influire negativamente sullo show, Carly e Freddie fanno di tutto per far sì che Sam e il suo nuovo fidanzato si lascino.

programme.title: iCarly: L'appostamento
programme.desc: La polizia di Seattle è sulle tracce di un venditore di DVD pirata che compare per caso in una delle trasmissioni di iCarly. Due poliziotti organizzano un appostamento nell'appartamento di Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Scuola nuova, amici nuovi
programme.desc: Carly riceve un invito per un colloquio con la preside della Briarwood, una scuola costosa e rinomata.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherma e schermaglie
programme.desc: Nonostante Freddie si diverta a passare il tempo libero con Carly e Sam a realizzare il web-show, sente l'esigenza di stare anche con dei ragazzi e fare cose da "maschi".

programme.title: iCarly: Vinci un incontro galante
programme.desc: Gibby è segretamente innamorato di Shannon, ma sa che non riuscirà mai a conquistarla, perché a lei piace Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 1
programme.desc: Il web show iCarly è stato nominato agli International iWeb Awards. Carly, Sam e Freddie partono alla volta del Giappone accompagnati da Spencer e dalla madre di Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 2
programme.desc: Salvati da un poliziotto, Carly e i suoi amici arrivano in albergo. Qui incontrano Kyoko e Yuki, due ragazzi il cui web show è in lizza per lo stesso premio per cui è stato candidato iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 3
programme.desc: Spencer e la Sig.ra Benson trovano i ragazzi e li riportano a Tokyo, dove lo spettacolo degli iWeb Awards è già cominciato. Le guardie di sicurezza però non vogliono farli entrare.

programme.title: iCarly: L'ho visto prima io!
programme.desc: Freddie ha invitato un amico all'iCarly show e sia Carly che Sam si prendono una cotta per lui appena il nuovo ragazzo entra nello studio.

programme.title: iCarly: La partita infinita
programme.desc: Spencer trova in una discarica un vecchio videogioco e da quando comincia a giocarci, non riesce più a staccarsi.

programme.title: iCarly: Il debito di Sam
programme.desc: Sam ha collezionato un debito molto consistente con Carly e Freddie, che le chiedono di restituire i soldi.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherzo col botto
programme.desc: In una puntata del loro web show, Carly, Sam e Freddie fanno uno scherzo "in diretta" a Lewbert, il portiere del palazzo in cui vive Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: La ricetta segreta
programme.desc: Carly e i suoi amici vanno pazzi per la torta con la crema al cocco del signor Galini, un anziano pasticcere italiano.

programme.title: iCarly: L'albero magnetico
programme.desc: Siamo a Natale e Spencer, anziché portare in casa un abete tradizionale, ha costruito un albero natalizio con materiale di scarto.

programme.title: iCarly: Il primo bacio
programme.desc: Sam scopre che Freddie non ha mai baciato una ragazza e per vendicarsi, lo dice a tutti durante una puntata di iCarly.

programme.title: True Jackson: Lo Spettacolo Teatrale
programme.desc: Ryan ha una cotta per Kelsey, una sua compagna di scuola. Lulu e True consigliano a Ryan di entrare a far parte del gruppo di teatro della scuola, di cui fa parte anche Kelsey.

programme.title: True Jackson: L'appuntamento
programme.desc: Nonostante il divieto per i dipendenti della Mad Style di stingere rapporti intimi fra colleghi, True accetta un invito a cena da parte di Jimmy.

programme.title: True Jackson: Salvate Snackleberry
programme.desc: Libby Gibbles, presidente del prestigioso "Circolo della moda", incarica all'ultimo momento la Mad Style di organizzare la cena annuale dell'associazione.

programme.title: True Jackson: Un Incontro Regale
programme.desc: A True viene affidato il compito di disegnare l'abito per un principe. Quando la ragazza si reca al suo palazzo per prendergli le misure, scopre che il principe Gabriel non è mai uscito di casa!

programme.title: True Jackson: La Sala Scarti
programme.desc: True è pronta a presentare il suo ultimo modello al signor Madigan e ostenta sicurezza, perché il capo ha sempre apprezzato le sue creazioni. Il signor Madigan sembra essere entusiasta del vestito.

programme.title: True Jackson: Vincere La Paura
programme.desc: True deve presenziare a scuola, in occasione del "giorno del lavoro dopo la scuola" e vuole chiedere a Max di accompagnarla come ospite e relatore.

programme.title: True Jackson: Ondata Di Caldo
programme.desc: Alla Mad Style non funziona più l'aria condizionata. Fa molto caldo e Max vuole che True lavori su un nuovo design di cappotti invernali.

programme.title: True Jackson: True Va A Parigi - Parte 1
programme.desc: La fede nuziale della moglie di Max ha una crepa. True si offre di portarla a riparare prima che la moglie Doris se ne possa accorgere.

programme.title: True Jackson: True Va A Parigi - Parte 2 v
programme.sub-title: True Va A Parigi - Parte 2 v
programme.desc: True, Lulu e Max sono tenuti prigionieri da Karl Gustav nella sua tenuta a Parigi. Egli vuole che il team creativo disegni il più bel vestito del mondo per la figlia.

programme.title: True Jackson: Vera Magia
programme.desc: Vera Magia

programme.title: True Jackson: Vera Fortuna
programme.desc: True ha un appuntamento con un famoso critico di profumi. Sperando che una buona recensione aiuti il lancio della sua nuova linea di profumi, gli vuole sottoporre la nuova fragranza che ha creato.

programme.title: True Jackson: Mad Rocks
programme.desc: True affida a Lulu l'organizzazione del Rock in Fashion, un evento di beneficenza, ma non si fida e decide di seguirla. Lulu se ne accorge e decide di abbandonare l'organizzazione.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Segreto Di True
programme.desc: True e Jimmy si sono messi insieme, ma non possono lasciarsi andare in effusioni amorose in ufficio per via della politica aziendale sulle relazioni fra impiegati.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Giorno Degli Scherzi
programme.desc: Max indice il 5 di scherzaio (Burlaio), una festa olandese simile al primo di Aprile. tutti devono farsi degli scherzi e il migliore si aggiudicherà un premio.

programme.title: True Jackson: Elezioni Di Classe
programme.desc: Ms. Park comunica ai ragazzi che si terranno le elezioni per il presidente di classe. True all'inizio non vuole candidarsi, ma dopo essere stata sfidata da Kyle decide di farlo.

programme.title: True Jackson: L'esame Di Guida
programme.desc: È il compleanno di Jimmy e True è alle prese con i preparativi della sua festa a sorpresa. Nel frattempo, però, deve destreggiarsi fra il lavoro che il Signor Madignan le ha affidato e l'esame di scuola guida.

programme.title: True Jackson: True è Famosa
programme.desc: Un giornale pubblica un articolo su True Jackson, rivelazione della moda. Subito dopo, un attore della tv la invita a partecipare come sua accompagnatrice a una cerimonia di premiazione.

programme.title: True Jackson: Un Vero Disastro
programme.desc: True e Lulu progettano di uscire di nascosto dall'ufficio per andare a comprare i biglietti del concerto di B.o.b.. True vuole regalarli a Jimmy in ricordo di un pomeriggio perfetto tra loro.

programme.title: True Jackson: La Gita
programme.desc: La classe va in gita al parco storico di "Colonial Town", dove il tempo è fermo al 1776 e l'attore che interpreta Benjamin Franklin racconta una leggenda.

programme.title: True Jackson: Direttore Per Un Giorno
programme.desc: Durante una visita del Direttore Ruckman alla lezione di chimica di Mr. Jamison, un esperimento fallito di Ryan manda il Direttore in ospedale.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Nuovo Negozio
programme.desc: Mad Style apre un nuovo negozio nel centro commerciale di Midtown, e True e Lulu sono mandate sul posto da Amanda per controllare che tutto sia in ordine.

programme.title: True Jackson: Fuga Dall'ufficio
programme.desc: Max, con una scusa, trascina con sé Lulu e True al centro commerciale, convincendole a marinare il lavoro.

programme.title: True Jackson: Mistero In Perù Parte 1
programme.desc: Dal museo del Perù viene misteriosamente rubata una pietra preziosa, e True vorrebbe riuscire a ritrovarla per incassare la ricompensa di ventimila dollari!

programme.title: True Jackson: Mistero In Perù Parte 2
programme.desc: Dal museo del Perù viene misteriosamente rubata una pietra preziosa. Approfittando delle nozze tra Amanda e Brock, True parte con Lulu alla volta del Perù.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Credimi, fratello!
programme.desc: Josh e Drake decidono collaborare ad un progetto per la scuola e realizzare un video musicale. Drake vuole che partecipi anche la sua nuova ragazza che però sembra un po’ troppo interessata a Josh.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La prima cotta
programme.desc: Josh ha una cotta per una sua compagna, Kathy, ma quando deve rivolgerle la parola balbetta e dice tante assurdità. Drake decide di aiutarlo, ma Josh racconta una bugia e complica la situazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La nonna
programme.desc: Audrey, Walter e Megan si preparano a partire per il weekend e Drake e Josh già pregustano due giorni di libertà ma i loro sogni vengono infranti quando scoprono che la nonna verrà a stare da loro.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La chitarra
programme.desc: Drake vince dei biglietti per il concerto degli Zero Gravity. Oltre a questi e a un pass per il backstage, gli viene regalata una chitarra autografata dal cantante del gruppo ma Josh combina un guaio.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La scommessa
programme.desc: Josh e Drake scommettono rispettivamente di non giocare più ai videogame e di non mangiare più schifezze. Chi perde dovrà tingersi i capelli di rosa. Anche mamma e papà scommettono su chi vincerà.

programme.desc: Juan quiere marcharse lejos con sus hermanos para que Libia se olvide de ese amor, pero una verdad golpea el honor de la familia Reyes, mientras Bernardo esconde que es un hombre casado.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la muerte y el engaño de Elizondo, Libia va a la hacienda, se siente desamparada y no aguanta más al ser fuertemente humillada por Gabriela, la viuda de Bernardo, y sus hijas.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan, Óscar y Franco reconocen el cadáver de su hermana y acusan al hacendado como el asesino. Norma Elizondo se opone a las decisiones de su madre y desafía los deseos de su esposo Fernando.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Los Reyes consiguen la dirección de la hacienda de los Elizondo y van a reclamar justicia. Gabriela se siente agobiada y toma vacaciones en su casa de la Florida, viaja con Norma y Fernando.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena y Sara Elizondo están cautivadas con los empleados que recibe Eva en la hacienda. Juan pelea con Franco por culpa de Rosario, la cantante del bar, y por oponerse a su venganza.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Óscar propone una manera de desquitarse de los Elizondo sin mancharse las manos de sangre. Gabriela regresa sin avisar y entrevista a los trabajadores, Juan no puede ocultar su rabia y dolor.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan acepta seducir a las Elizondo, sus hermanos se preocupan por su actitud al conocer a Norma. Gabriela presiona a su hija para que comience a corresponderle a Fernando como esposa.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena cita a Franco en un parque y se besan, él quiere ir más allá. Norma y Fernando celebran su primer aniversario de matrimonio en el bar, él se deslumbra con la presentación de Rosario.

programme.desc: When Stubing meets a gorgeous movie queen (Joan Collins), who recently shed her ninth husband, he is fascinated by her charm and beauty. Then, a man decides to prioritize golf over his wife, so the neglected woman decides to play ball with an old friend.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Discount Romance/ Vicky'S Dilemma/ Loser, And Still Champ
programme.desc: The captain's daughter is put in a tough situation she is accused of stealing supplements from Doc's office. Then, Gopher's uncle (Red Button) falls in love with the lady who runs the ship's gift shop.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: So Help Me Hannah/ The Maid Cleans Up/ Cpr, I.O.U
programme.desc: The vivacious Hannah Harvye (Mary Martin) immediately becomes involved with the crew and rekindles a romance with an old flame. An unassuming man (Ben Murphy) finds himself in a tight situation with a maid he's never met. Gopher saves a man's life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators And Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: Las hermanitas Calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature venue des profondeurs
programme.desc: Michelangelo devient ami avec un alligator mutant déséquilibré qui est en possession d'un étrange outil de technologie appartenant aux Krangs. Mais est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une fille mystérieuse
programme.desc: Las d'entendre les critiques de Raph, Léo laisse son frère diriger l'équipe. Pendant ce temps, Léo rencontre une belle et dangereuse kunoïchi.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Roi des Rats
programme.desc: Les tortues doivent faire face à nouvel ennemi, le Roi des Rats, qui menace de prendre le contrôle de la ville, mais aussi de l'esprit de Splinter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le plan des Krangs
programme.desc: Quand les devoirs d'école d'April attirent l'attention des Krangs, les tortues prennent le lycée d'assaut.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Les tortues ont un problème avec le Pulvériseur, un adolescent qui se prend pour un héros et qui veut combattre le crime à leurs côtés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mystère au TCRI
programme.desc: En s'introduisant dans l'enceinte très surveillée du TCRI, les tortues découvrent les véritables intentions des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cafard Terminator
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles tentent de déjouer le plan d'invasion de la Terre par les Krangs, les tortues sont pourchassées par un cafard géant et indestructible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le labyrinthe de la peur
programme.desc: Fatigué d'être humilié par Fishface et Dogpound, et de perdre face aux tortues, Baxter Stockman prépare sa vengeance.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.desc: The brush country of South Texas has been a living laboratory — and a proving ground — where true visionaries and pure dedication transformed what we know about managing the whitetail. Join us on a road trip that brings us across legendary ranches, deep into groundbreaking research, and through stories of the men who helped build the modern whitetail movement.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Nearly 7 years after her husband’s tragic and unexpected passing, Nana returns to her farm and embraces the healing power of whitetail hunting.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Meredith learns the value of the Trash Can Slam on a flounder trip with - Capt. Justin that turns into a multi-species challenge.”

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin Leake and Meredith McCord divert attention from what’s not happening with the tarpon bite to using CoastMaster, light tackle and experience to find snapper success on heavily fished public spots.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: I picked up a $73 water tank and turned it into a DIY deer watering hole. After placing it out and filling it up, I wanted to see how long it would take for deer to actually find it and start using it. It took 5 days before the first deer showed up, and from there the results were really cool to watch. Adding water can be a game-changer for your hunting property, especially in the hot summer and early fall months when natural water sources can be limited. In this video, I’ll walk you through the setup, show trail camera footage of the deer discovering the tank, and share what I learned from this simple experiment. If you’re thinking about creating a watering hole for deer on your land, this is one of the most affordable and effective ways to do it that I have found.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kokila tells Kunwar that she has planned something which will really cause trouble. Raja mata overhears their conversation and doesn't allow Kokila to leave the room and to stop her sabotage. Kokila and Kunwar manage to exchange the clothes that Gayatri is to wear while she spends the night with Ranaji. The clothes that are exchanged were the same clothes that belonged to Ranaji's late wife, Sulakshana. How will Ranaji react when he sees Gayatri dressed in Sulakshana's clothes? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj Mata meets Indravadhan and learns that he is not going to have his first night. He claims that he only loves Sulakshana and nobody else. It is time and Gayatri gets ready and enters Indravadhan's room. Finding Gayatri dressed as Sulakshana, Indravadhan gets angry. He claims that she is making fun of his wounds. Gayatri claims that she knows nothing about what he is talking. Indravadhan claims that he does not love her. This puts Gayatri in shock and she questions Indravadhan as to why did he save her every time. What will Indravadhan have to say now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds out that Ranaji doesn't love her, she goes outside and gets drenched in the rain and cires. She questions why Ranaji married her even though he doesn't love her. Ranaji goes to meet Gayatri and says that her behaviour is not representative of a queen. Gayatri replies that she is not a queen but a common girl with a broken heart. What will Ranaji have to say to Gayatri now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri confronts Indravadhan with more questions and asks him to answer all of them. She asks Indravadhan the reason for his hatred towards her. Indravadhan claims the reason why he hates her is because of the treachery she and her father have done in order to make her the queen of Ameerkot. Indravadhan also informs Gayatri about the deal that her father and Raj Mata have made. Gayatri is left flabbergasted hearing this and claims that she knows nothing about the deal. At the same time, Raj Mata meets Gayatri and asks her to get ready for another ritual that needs to be completed. Will Gayatri accept to carry out the ritual even after learning that Indravadhan does not love her? Keep watching to find out.
